messages:
Anya (PM): Quick sync idea 1: hardware-aware onboarding windows to batch model entries by GPU family and region. Hoping to reduce benchmark noise and simplify infra reservations.

Carl (Infra): Makes sense. If we reserve Dedicated pools per-window we can avoid noisy autoscaling events. We'll need deterministic placement tags though.

Maria (Eng-ML): Be explicit about bench slices. A100/H100 behave differently at longer context. Bench against: chat (<=128), mid-docs (128-512), long-docs (512-2048). Also sample KV-cache hit patterns.

Sam (ProdOps): Ops ask: can the onboarding tool accept a "preferred_gpu_family" manifest field? That would let scheduling choose the right reserved pool automatically.

Leo (Solutions): Customer request: EU-only onboarding windows for customers with data residency needs. Also want a clear migration opt-in flow so they don't get forced into a new model during their pilot.

Anya (PM): Draft window plan:
- eu-a100-week: 2026-06-07 -> 2026-06-13 (EU-only, A100 reserved)
- global-h100-speed: 2026-06-21 -> 2026-06-27 (H100 reserved, global)
Goals: reduce cross-hardware variance, enable controlled canaries, 48h stabilization before general catalog exposure.

Maria (Eng-ML): Bench metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec, failure rate, memory peak, and a quality delta metric (eval set score change). We'll need samples for seed randomness control.

Carl (Infra): Engineering changes: disable startup-burst autoscaling during windows, add reserve tags, and export a predictable scheduling plan for the runbook. If pool saturates route to compatible variant with a "degraded-perf" flag and page oncall.

onboard-bot: Created runbook template: hw-onboard-2026-v1, owners: @Anya, @Maria, @Carl.

Sam (ProdOps): Pinning/migration flow question: if a tenant is pinned to v1, do we delay migrations until the tenant's next matching window? Need default + opt-in immediate path.

Anya (PM): Proposed policy: default = schedule migrations to the next matching hardware/region window. Immediate migration allowed via support with an explicit "migration-accelerate" tag. Max forced delay configurable up to 90 days.

Leo (Solutions): Add short migration notes per model: tokenizer differences, API parity, known perf tradeoffs, and recommended rollout guardrails for customers. We should publish a one-page FAQ.

Maria (Eng-ML): Quality gate: 5% A/B holdback for 7 days; fail if eval delta > 2% on key slices. Also run a small-scale stress test for KV-cache correctness.

Carl (Infra): Fallback performance thresholds: document expected p95 delta range when routing to alternate-family variants. If delta > 30% trigger rollback.

Anya (PM): Action items & owners: finalize window calendar by Friday (Anya), bench matrix + harness (Maria), autoscaler + tags prototype (Carl), migration ticket template (Sam), customer FAQ + comms (Leo). I'll draft the runbook and link PRs.

Maria (Eng-ML): I'll open PR for eval harness and add the slice definitions.

Sam (ProdOps): I'll create the ticket template and tag taxonomy in the ops playbook.

Carl (Infra): I'll put a staging prototype of autoscaler changes up and post perf snapshots mid-week.

Leo (Solutions): I'll draft customer-facing FAQ and sample migration email.

Anya (PM): Thanks all 1. If no objections I'll formalize the schedule and publish the runbook by EOD Friday. :thumbsup:
